title: minimapcluster
summary: MSUI's minimap cluster carries the current Benilla chrome and implemented behaviors: round border/top band, PvP-tinted zone text with territory/arena tooltip, sounded body show/hide toggle, bound-aware stateful/sounded zoom controls plus wheel zoom, aura-driven tracking icon with spell tooltip and right-click cancel, unread-mail icon and exact tooltip, party/resource dots, and player arrow. Painterly square mode is an intentional alternate presentation. Current Benilla's separately implemented day/night indicator is tracked under ui/gametime; its explicitly scoped-out ping, battlefield and meeting-stone work remains out here too.

openItems.text: Zone text is always gold - no PVP-type tinting (friendly green / hostile red / contested orange) and no zone hover tooltip with the territory line
openItems.resolution: 2026-08-21: AreaTable now exposes leaf flags and top-level FactionGroupMask; MinimapUiLaw applies the reference friend-then-enemy disposition, exact friendly/hostile/contested tints, arena red override, territory lines and PvP Area hover line.

openItems.text: Zoom buttons never grey at bounds (reference disables ZoomIn at max, ZoomOut at 0) and play no igMiniMapZoomIn/Out sounds
openItems.resolution: 2026-08-21: Zoom controls now select exact Up/Down/Disabled/Highlight assets, disable at the active outdoor/interior projection endpoint, and play igMiniMapZoomIn/Out only on a real step; wheel zoom observes the same endpoint/sound law.

openItems.text: Minimap toggle plays no igMiniMapOpen/Close sounds
openItems.resolution: 2026-08-21: All minimap visibility changes flow through SetMinimapVisible and play exact igMiniMapOpen/Close cues.

openItems.text: Mail icon has no 'You have unread mail' hover tooltip
openItems.resolution: 2026-08-21: The pending-mail icon now owns a shared plain tooltip containing the byte-exact enUS text 'You have unread mail'.

openItems.text: No minimap ping or battlefield/meeting-stone buttons (current Benilla also scopes these out). The day/night indicator is now implemented and tracked separately under ui/gametime.

Focused law/source checks pass. Needs live scaled pixel and audio verification across friendly, hostile, contested and arena zones; outdoor/interior zoom endpoints; pending mail; and an active tracking aura.
